scores.tell: Chair on a flat horizon-split floor with a hard line behind. The view is a bit high and the legs splay unevenly. The ground plane is plain and has no texture or depth layers.
Slide, pool and tiled deck sit at one consistent high three-quarter angle with a pattern background. The tile perspective is slightly strong. Otherwise it is close to real.

The dish is tilted at an odd angle, and the base sits in dunes with no clear ground. The dune background is a wide, deep scene, while real cards use simpler depth. The viewpoints of the dish and the base do not match.
None. Mild perspective, a clear sign layer, and a sky layer with soft clouds. It matches the real cards.
Glass seen straight on with the rim ellipse. The purple floor line is flat, and the umbrella and straw view is a little inconsistent. Depth is simple, like the real glass card.
The saucer is seen from a high three-quarter angle on a plain concentric background. The view is consistent. There is no ground, which matches the real floating-object cards.
Wide landscape with a deep background of trees and a path. The table is viewed from high above, and the stool tops use a different angle. There are too many depth layers, unlike the tight real cards.
Ship in a three-quarter view with waves as the foreground layer and a rays background. Perspective is mild. The hull and sails are slightly inconsistent.
Frontal door with ivy and a foreground pavers strip. Depth layers are close and clear, and perspective is mild. It reads like the real window and door cards.

The gravestone has a high three-quarter view, with a hard horizon split behind it. The side face is steeper than the front, so the perspective is a little forced. The flat background has no depth layers.
